find: return { rebuild: drawn !== null, draws: ages(0, target) };
replace: return { rebuild: false, draws: ages(0, target) };
why: The moment builders feed each tick's events once and never rewind. A backward scrub that replays ages 0..N onto the build that already drew past N shows frame N under the later frames' particles, so the same frame position would draw a different picture depending on how it was reached.
